item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena wants to find out whether the temperature of water affects how quickly sugar dissolves.

She plans two trials in her kitchen at home.

Which row shows a fair test?

options.A: Trial 1: 40 g sugar, 100 cm³ water at 30 °C; Trial 2: 40 g sugar, 100 cm³ water at 60 °C
options.B: Trial 1: 40 g sugar, 100 cm³ water at 30 °C; Trial 2: 60 g sugar, 100 cm³ water at 60 °C
options.C: Trial 1: 40 g sugar, 100 cm³ water at 60 °C; Trial 2: 40 g sugar, 150 cm³ water at 60 °C
options.D: Trial 1: 40 g sugar, 100 cm³ water at 30 °C, stirred; Trial 2: 40 g sugar, 100 cm³ water at 60 °C, not stirred
